valuation.method: Forward Operating EPS x Justified P/E (FY2027 operating EPS viewed at the 12-month target date)

bear.driver: Regulatory lag or slower data-center load ramp compresses valuation multiple and keeps earnings at the low end of guidance

base.driver: Midpoint FY2027 operating EPS execution supported by 9%-11% long-term growth outlook (2027-2031) and transmission/data-center capex

bull.driver: Accelerated hyperscaler load commitments and constructive rate-case outcomes support top-end earnings and a premium regulated-utility multiple

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027 operating EPS of $6.90, the $129.18 close implies 18.7x P/E; the published consensus average target of $139.83 implies 20.3x base EPS (or $7.17 EPS at 19.5x).
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $6.90 (5.3 pp of price return).
valuation.watch_metric: Data-center and commercial load commitments (GW pipeline) and regulatory rate-case / capital-plan execution
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 / FY2026 earnings release and FY2026 Form 10-K (expected February 2027)

analyst_notes: Published consensus (MarketBeat / Investing.com) shows a Moderate Buy rating (roughly 16 Buy/Strong Buy, 8 Hold) with an average price target of ~$139.83 (+8.2% vs. $129.18 close, +4.0 pp above the $134.55 base case). Named 2026 broker targets span $130 to $154, including Evercore ISI (Nicholas Amicucci, Outperform, $154), Jefferies (Julien Dumoulin-Smith, Buy, $153), Wells Fargo (Shahriar Pourreza, Overweight, $149), BofA Securities (Ross Fowler, $135), BMO Capital (James Thalacker, Market Perform, $135), Barclays (Nicholas Campanella, Equal-Weight, $132), and Morgan Stanley (David Arcaro, Overweight, $130). Individual events are omitted (aggregate_only) because exact issue timestamps for each note were not verified from primary broker filings.
